VAMPIRES CAN'T SEE  (v0.11.0)

You are a vampire, and you cannot see. You echolocate like a bat: every click sends a sonar pulse through a medieval village at night, and the walls light up for a moment and fade. People are never drawn directly. A pulse that reaches someone leaves a fading echo of their outline where they stood. Ping again to see where they went.

Find a villager, drink in the dark, and be back in your crypt (or a safe, dark spot) before dawn. Survive five nights to win the run.


HOW TO PLAY
Download the zip, unzip it, and double-click index.html. It runs in your browser (Chrome, Edge or Firefox). No install, no server, no network: the game makes no web requests at all.
Click the title screen once to turn sound on. Headphones are strongly recommended: sound comes from where it happens, and it is half the game.


CONTROLS
  Left-click / Space ....... sonar pulse (works while you hold someone, too)
  W A S D / arrow keys ..... move and turn (mouse turns too)
  Hold right-click / R ..... grab and drink from someone in front of you
  Hold E while drinking .... restrain your victim (muffled, but you drink at half speed)
  E ........................ open or close a door; sleep at your crypt or a safe spot
  G ........................ throw a rock (3 per run): loud clatter that lures villagers
  Q  Shriek ................ pulse reaches twice as far, scatters a crowd (unlocks night 1)
  Shift / C  Mist .......... silent 2-cell dash (unlocks night 2)
  F  Still ................. five seconds where nothing you do alarms anyone (unlocks night 3)
  Esc ...................... pause
Settings has options for reduced motion, large text, wobbly lines, and click-to-drink instead of hold.


THE RULES OF THE NIGHT
- A night runs 20:00 to 06:00 and lasts 4 minutes of real time by default (adjustable in Settings).
- You start each night with 10% blood and it drains faster every night. Below 25% you are weak and your pulses shrink.
- Drinking fills the bar. Each villager holds 30 to 50 blood. Full villagers struggle, and may tear free and scream. Let go early and they run off dazed.
- Light is danger. Torchlight shows you to people; the eye-and-ticks "veil" meter next to your blood vial shows how exposed you are. Drink in the dark.
- Drink after your blood is full and the extra fills an overflow bar. Fill it and you pick a gift. Two gifts per night.
- At dawn, if you are outdoors, the run is lost. You can only sleep from 04:30 on.
- Between nights spend Essence in the shop and pick a boon. Runs are different every time.


THE VILLAGE IS ALIVE (new)
Villagers now keep a medieval night routine. They draw water, drink at the tavern, pray in the church and cook, eat and mend at home. By 01:00 nearly everyone is indoors and abed, easy prey for a vampire who gets inside. Two watchmen patrol the streets all night in opposite directions. A gravedigger, a drunk and an insomniac keep strange hours. Watch the town and learn the pattern.


SAVING
Your run saves automatically in this browser. Use Export save to keep a copy as a .json file. Nothing leaves your machine.


DEBUG TOOLS
Add ?debug=1 to the page address (or press F9 for the dev panel) for logs, the F3 overlay, a top-down map (M), and test hooks. Handy for bug reports: the dev panel has a "Copy error report" button. If you hit a crash or a bug, please paste that report into a comment.


FEEDBACK
This is an early build and changes often. Balance feedback is especially welcome: drain speed, how many gifts per night, how scary the village feels, and what you'd like villagers to do next.
